title: Top 10% Trial Sites by Enrollment Rate
prompt: You are analyzing clinical trial site performance. Write a query to identify the top 10% of trial sites by their enrollment rate (enrolled_participants divided by target_enrollment). The enrollment rate should be calculated as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 for 85% enrollment). Return only sites whose enrollment rate falls in the top 10% across all sites. If multiple sites are tied exactly at the 10% cutoff boundary, include all tied sites. Output columns: site_id, site_name, enrolled_participants, target_enrollment, enrollment_rate (rounded to 4 decimal places). Order results by enrollment_rate descending, then by site_id ascending.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE trial_sites (site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, site_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, trial_phase VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, enrolled_participants INTEGER NOT NULL, target_enrollment INTEGER NOT NULL, principal_investigator VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL);

composite_moves: rank-partition: compute PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY enrollment_rate DESC)
row-transform: round enrollment_rate to 4 decimal places
sort: ORDER BY enrollment_rate DESC, site_id ASC

hints: You need to calculate a rate by dividing two columns, then identify which rows fall in the top 10% of that rate.
Use PERCENT_RANK() with a window ordered by your calculated rate in descending order. PERCENT_RANK returns 0 for the highest value and approaches 1 for lower values when ordered DESC.
Filter for rows where PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY enrollment_rate DESC) <= 0.10. Use a CTE to calculate the rate first, then apply PERCENT_RANK in a second CTE, and filter in the final SELECT.
answer_key:
WITH enrollment_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    site_id,
    site_name,
    enrolled_participants,
    target_enrollment,
    enrolled_participants::NUMERIC / target_enrollment AS enrollment_rate
  FROM trial_sites
),
ranked_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    site_id,
    site_name,
    enrolled_participants,
    target_enrollment,
    enrollment_rate,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY enrollment_rate DESC) AS pct_rank
  FROM enrollment_rates
)
SELECT 
  site_id,
  site_name,
  enrolled_participants,
  target_enrollment,
  ROUND(enrollment_rate, 4) AS enrollment_rate
FROM ranked_sites
WHERE pct_rank <= 0.10
ORDER BY enrollment_rate DESC, site_id ASC;
